STATUS: CONFLICT
The sources give two different FS values for hard filtering of SNPs:
- FS > 60.0, from threshold FS_gt_60_snp in procedure HF-01 [G:Procedure:HF-01] [G:Threshold:FS_gt_60_snp]
- FS > 45, from the clinic protocol note, which states that an SNP is hard-filtered when FS > 45 [fx_clinic_fs]
The context does not say which value should be used.
